name: @mechanica-labs/goliath
description: Hermes-native browser hands for AI agents: persistent sessions, human-like actions, and secure uploads over MCP
author: Mechanica Labs

tools.name: goliath_create_tab
tools.description: Open a new browser tab at a URL

tools.name: goliath_snapshot
tools.description: Get accessibility snapshot with element refs

tools.name: goliath_observe
tools.description: Get versioned semantic state, diffs, readiness, and provenance

tools.name: goliath_plan_action
tools.description: Create and policy-check a semantic action contract

tools.name: goliath_execute_action
tools.description: Execute and verify a semantic action contract

tools.name: goliath_extract
tools.description: Extract typed data with confidence and provenance

tools.name: goliath_handoff
tools.description: Pause or resume a tab for human takeover

tools.name: goliath_checkpoint
tools.description: Create a session storage checkpoint

tools.name: goliath_fork
tools.description: Fork an isolated session from a checkpoint

tools.name: goliath_click
tools.description: Click an element by ref or CSS selector

tools.name: goliath_type
tools.description: Type text into an element

tools.name: goliath_navigate
tools.description: Navigate to URL or search macro

tools.name: goliath_scroll
tools.description: Scroll page up/down/left/right

tools.name: goliath_hands
tools.description: Run an ordered multi-step UI workflow in one tab

tools.name: goliath_behavior
tools.description: Get bounded behavioral timing-diversity telemetry

tools.name: goliath_act
tools.description: Press keys, hover, wait, select options, and drag elements

tools.name: goliath_upload
tools.description: Attach files from the configured upload directory

tools.name: goliath_screenshot
tools.description: Capture page screenshot

tools.name: goliath_close_tab
tools.description: Close a browser tab

tools.name: goliath_evaluate
tools.description: Execute JavaScript in a Goliath tab page context

tools.name: goliath_list_tabs
tools.description: List open tabs for a user

tools.name: goliath_import_cookies
tools.description: Import Netscape cookie file (requires GOLIATH_API_KEY)

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run generate-openapi && npm test && npm run test:packed-install
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.js && node scripts/generate-openapi.js && git add goliath.config.json openclaw.plugin.json openapi.json README.md docs/HARNESS_SETUP.md
